items.title: Ralph Humphrey interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: His wife Ruth was on the group as a percussion... So I mean just that core right there was phenomenal.

ctx.x: Was Ian Underwood on that gig?

Ian was on that group. His wife Ruth was on the group as a percussion, Jean Luc Ponty was in the band, George Duke, keyboard player, was in the band. So I mean just that core right there was phenomenal.
Wow. When you look back on that — I’m going to stop for a second — do you smell something burning? Just cigarette smoke As long as we’re not
